name: engcon AB (publ)
summary: engcon AB (publ) engages in the design, production, and sale of excavator tools in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, rest of Europe, North and South America, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, and internationally. The company offers control systems; track and wheel control products; DC2, a proportional control system with remote support; MIG2, an integrated hand support joystick; EC-Oil, an automatic hydraulic coupling; positioning systems; locking systems; Q-Safe Light Module, a control system of warning light and sound modules; and attachment brackets.
